attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Salt prices at Bramblewick hold steady","reason":"Briefing gives no salt price news at Bramblewick."},{"span":"north of town","reason":"Location of the salt flats is not given."},{"span":"its escort numbers exceed cargo loads","reason":"Repeats an earlier bulletin rather than the briefing, which only says the caravan reached the ford."},{"span":"the Company seized three small fishing vessels during a routine patrol along the western shore","reason":"Event, number and place are not in the briefing."},{"span":"roughly two thousand credits","reason":"Invented number and currency."},{"span":"rumors of sabotage persist among the Tannerfolk regarding the pirate supply lines","reason":"Event not in the briefing."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin invents a ship seizure, a sum of credits, sabotage rumours and locations, and it recycles the caravan-guards joke from an earlier bulletin.
